scripts.build:packages: npm run build:core && npm run build:addon-server && npm run build:translated-subtitles && node scripts/copy-packages.js
scripts.build:translated-subtitles: node -e "const {existsSync}=require('fs'); const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); if(!existsSync('../translated-subtitles/package.json')){console.log('skip translated-subtitles (package not present)');process.exit(0);} const r=spawnSync('npm',['run','build'],{cwd:'../translated-subtitles',stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); process.exit(r.status??1);"
